exact_claim: IPL 2025-2027 player regulations establish match fee of ₹7.5 Lakhs per match, total team cap ₹157 Cr for 2027.
CCI approved acquisition of controlling interest in EMSH (RR parent) by Westview Cricket (~75%) and Poonawalla Sports (~18%).
CSK and SRH trade completed: Livingstone (₹6 Cr) & Edwards (₹3 Cr) to CSK; Khaleel (₹4.8 Cr) & Ellis (₹2 Cr) to SRH.
Nathan Ellis traded from CSK to SRH in four-player swap involving Livingstone.
Hardik traded to PBKS for Arshdeep; Pant traded to DC for Kuldeep; Natarajan traded to SRH.
RR and LSG engaged in trade talks involving Mohammed Shami and Sam Curran, with M Siddharth also understood to be part of the deal.
IPL 2027 retention list deadline confirmed for November 17, 2026; Mini-auction scheduled for December 16, 2026 in Goa.
Player auction register closes Nov 23; franchise wishlist submission Dec 1; final auction register Dec 3; auction Dec 16.
Rajasthan Royals posted league-highest powerplay run rate (11.67) and tournament-high 181 sixes in IPL 2026.
RR middle-overs scoring dipped to 9.07 in overs 7-11; conceded 9.71 economy in overs 7-11; Deshpande conceded 11.96 economy.
Jofra Archer took 29 wickets in IPL 2026 carrying 27.6% of RR bowling wickets.
Qualifier 2 official scorecard: GT defeated RR by 4 wickets; RR middle bowling conceded 82 runs in overs 7-14.
MI and PBKS complete direct 1-for-1 player swap of Hardik Pandya and Arshdeep Singh.
RR officials dismiss Yashasvi Jaiswal trade rumours; confirm opener is non-transferable cornerstone.
Clauses 1.2.5 and 1.2.6 mandate maximum 4 overseas players on field at any time including Impact Player.
